body.subject: Issue #582 custody slice: the four pending files import the shared-workspace-custody helper instead of inline shape copies

items.change: Every inline copy of the ws-<32 hex> shape in application.mjs, index.mjs, swarm-state.mjs and worktree.mjs now calls isPhysicalWorkspaceId from shared-workspace-custody.mjs; the two worktree.mjs receipt-filename patterns derive from the newly exported PHYSICAL_WORKSPACE_ID_TOKEN_SOURCE, so the definition file spells the token once and no other file spells it at all.
items.evidence: issue428/issue364/shared-workspace-custody 20/20 green and issue286-custody-predicate 5/5 green on the committed tree; the custody gate row reports 0 findings; 138/138 green over the worktree, reconcile, resume, coupling and driver-wiring batch; node --check clean on all five files; the two derived receipt-name patterns were compared against the removed literals over a 19-name corpus with identical captures and match positions.

environmentRed: impl/test/issue360-drain-releases-settled.test.mjs :: 360b the drain releases and names the capacity reservation a stopped seat left behind — fails on the clean target cd26b9b2 as well, at load average above 20 with three sibling suites running
impl/test/phase56-drain-and-close.test.mjs :: DC4 drain convergence deadline — fails on the clean target cd26b9b2 as well

carriedForward: The five files landed inside the mcp-lead13 composite commit 658c02f2 rather than a commit of their own: a peer committed the shared checkout while this slice was uncommitted, so the commit subject is the composite one.

The test path this slice brief named, test/issue364-worktree-custody-on-stop.test.mjs, does not exist; test/issue428-worktree-custody-on-stop.test.mjs is the custody-on-stop file and test/issue364-runtime-lost-on-restart.test.mjs is the #364 file.
